full_name: Lucy Salyer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2003–2004 Law Constance E. Smith Fellow University of New Hampshire
bio: Lucy Salyer is an associate professor of history at the University of New Hampshire, who specializes in the social and legal history of immigration and citizenship in the United States after the Civil War.
